description: This is the official list of land-based emergency shelters in the British Virgin Islands for the 2026 hurricane season, published by the territory's Department of Disaster Management. The download page, dated 4 June 2026, offers one printer-friendly file of about 680 KB with the full list, which residents use to find the designated shelter nearest to them before a storm. It is free to download from the department's website, which also hosts related preparedness material such as a tsunami fact sheet. Caveats: only the download page was read here, so the number of shelters, their capacities and whether locations are given are unverified; the file is a printable document, not a dataset; it is replaced each season; and no licence is stated. Coverage is the whole territory. Simulation uses: shelter locations for evacuation and shelter-demand models in a small island territory, and checking shelter exposure to storm surge. Related records: the Belize national emergency shelter list (data-nemo-belize-national-emergency-shelter-list) is a comparable Caribbean shelter register.
